reply_text:
Pushing to `origin` is now disabled in `~/code/mfuton-share`. I tested it with a dry-run push to `origin`, and git refused.

- **Default push target:** a plain `git push` from any branch, including `main`, now goes to `fork`.
- **Fetching and pulling:** these still come from Rob's repo, so `git pull` keeps `main` up to date with his work.

If you ever need to undo the block, run `git remote set-url --push origin git@github.com:electric-samurai/mfuton-share.git`.
